title: Reward Point Value, Redemption Block and Point Life Across the Circle Tiers
content:
## Redemption value, block size and point life

Three figures govern what a reward point on a Northbeam Circle Membership is worth and how long it
lasts. The value figure is the redemption value of 100 reward points in USD. The block figure is the
smallest block of points that may be redeemed at once. The life figure is the months a point stays live
from the month it was earned.

| Tier | Value of 100 points (USD) | Smallest redeemable block (points) | Point life (months) |
|---|---|---|---|
| Circle Free Membership | 0.50 | 500 | 12 |
| Circle Plus Annual | 0.75 | 250 | 18 |
| Circle Total Annual | 1.00 | 100 | 24 |
| Circle Total Household Annual | 1.00 | 100 | 24 |
| Circle Business Pro | 1.10 | 100 | 24 |
| Circle Business Elite | 1.25 | 100 | 36 |

Two further entries are carried per tier rather than as amounts: whether points may be transferred to
another profile, and whether a yearly points statement is issued to the member.

| Tier | Transfer to another profile | Yearly points statement |
|---|---|---|
| Circle Free Membership | no | no |
| Circle Plus Annual | no | yes |
| Circle Total Annual | yes | yes |
| Circle Total Household Annual | yes | yes |
| Circle Business Pro | yes | yes |
| Circle Business Elite | yes | yes |

## Points of judgement on this schedule

*What is a block of points worth on each tier?* On Circle Free Membership the smallest block is 500
points and 100 points are worth 0.50, so one block is worth 2.50. On Circle Plus Annual two blocks of 250
points, 500 points together, are worth 3.75 at 0.75 per 100 points. On Circle Total Annual and Circle Total
Household Annual a block of 100 points at 1.00 per 100 points is worth 1.00. On Circle Business Pro a
block of 100 points at 1.10 per 100 points is worth 1.10, and on Circle Business Elite a block of 100
points at 1.25 per 100 points is worth 1.25.

*Which tiers issue a statement and allow a transfer?* Circle Free Membership does neither. Circle Plus
Annual issues the yearly statement but does not permit a transfer. Circle Total Annual, Circle Total
Household Annual, Circle Business Pro and Circle Business Elite do both. Point life runs from 12 months
on Circle Free Membership to 36 months on Circle Business Elite.
